evidence.quote: Globus Srl is an Italian manufacturer of advanced wood processing machinery, specializing in innovative size reduction technologies for the wood-based panel and recycling industries. Since its foundation in 1981 by Fabio Paron || With a strong presence in key markets such as China, India, North America, and Europe, and as part of the prestigious IMALPAL Group, Globus operates in over 40 countries through a global network of partners. || Since 1981, Globus designs and manufactures industrial wood processing equipment for particleboard, MDF, OSB, biomass and recycling applications.
